The *Informes sobre la Situación Económica, las Finanzas Públicas y la Deuda Pública* (SHCP quarterly reports) publish every quarter, in the public finance annex `itanfp02_<AAAA><TT>.xlsx`, sheet “I.II RecGobFed a) ISR”, ISR revenue (million pesos, cumulative January–quarter) by **annual income bracket declared by the taxpayer** (12 brackets, thousands of pesos) × **type** (legal persons; PF with business activity; PF without business activity; withholding on wages and salaries by PM and by PF; other auxiliary items), plus sector of activity and number of taxpayers who filed a return with payment; Q4 is the annual figure (Table 1b, new row; asset `raw/ITAN/itan-congelado.zip`, catalog `05_scripts/itan-catalogo.json`, `AccesoITAN.ado` → `master/itan-isr-rangos.dta`, 2019-1 … 2026-3). **Methodological note:** (i) the bracket is of *declared annual income* (note 1_/ of the table; RIF via bimonthly returns), not of taxable base nor of ISR due: mapping it to the ENIGH requires assuming that declared income corresponds to the person's annual `ing_bruto_tax` (accruable income before deductions) and that the distribution *within* each bracket is that of the ENIGH; (ii) in the **withholding on wages and salaries** columns the “taxpayer” is the withholding agent (the employer: 584.5 of the 1,254.8 bn fall in “more than 500 million”), so those brackets rank firms, **not** employees: only the PF columns with and without business activity (77.117 bn in 2024) anchor PF liability by bracket; employees' liability is still anchored by total (`ISRAS` LIF = ITAN withholding on wages 1,254.807 to the peso); (iii) they are annual cumulative figures and preliminary SAT figures (the SHCP revised 2021 and 2022-Q3: Table 1b); (iv) “Resto” (remainder) = taxpayers without an annual return (412.9 bn of withholding) and the low PF brackets without business activity come out negative (refunds): the anchor by bracket is built on the 11 brackets with PF ≥ 0 and “Resto” is allocated ∝ ENIGH, declared. They are weighted sums by group: in Mata each replicate costs milliseconds. Up to v1.x each replicate ran PERF/INCI/CICLO/REC as programs with preserve/collapse/restore over the full database (~4 s per replicate on a database of 217 variables; B=100 × 20 variables ≈ 2-3 h). The five output files keep their schema because Perfiles.ado, FiscalGap.ado and CuentasGeneracionales.ado read them.

Propósito (procedencia: 03_help/Stata/Ga: Purpose (provenance: 03_help/Stata/GastoPC.sthlp “Descripción”; 03_help/manual-investigador-ciep.md §4.9): `GastoPC` computes per capita public spending by function (education, health, pensions, energy, infrastructure and other), distributing it across ENIGH individuals according to their socioeconomic characteristics: total spending on each function is divided by the number of beneficiaries identified in the ENIGH, assigning each individual the per capita amount according to their status (whether they attend school, whether they have health insurance, whether they receive a pension).
Propósito (procedencia: 03_help/Stata/LI: Purpose (provenance: 03_help/Stata/LIF.sthlp “Descripción”): `LIF` downloads and analyzes the federal government's budgetary revenue by combining three official sources: the Ley de Ingresos de la Federación (Federal Revenue Law; amounts approved by Congress), the SHCP's Estadísticas Oportunas (observed monthly revenue) and the BIE (GDP and deflator to express values as % of GDP). It allows querying historical revenue since 1993, comparing its evolution across years, analyzing the elasticity of each tax with respect to GDP and projecting the close of the current year.
Propósito (procedencia: 03_help/Stata/PE: Purpose (provenance: 03_help/Stata/PEF.sthlp “Descripción”): `PEF` downloads and analyzes federal public spending by combining, with an automatic priority hierarchy, the Cuenta Pública (spending executed), the approved PEF and the PPEF (draft budget), plus the BIE to express values as % of GDP. It lets you consult historical spending since 2013, compare its evolution across years, analyze the composition of spending by function (health, education, pensions, security, etc.) and assess its relation to GDP.
Propósito (procedencia: 03_help/Stata/PI: Purpose (provenance: 03_help/Stata/PIBDeflactor.sthlp “Descripción”): `PIBDeflactor` downloads, processes and projects Mexico's main macroeconomic indicators: GDP (PIB), price deflator, inflation and labor demographics. It is the base command of the Simulador Fiscal CIEP: it produces the deflator and the GDP that all other commands (LIF, PEF, SHRFSP, etc.) use to express values in real terms; the series are presented in three segments (observed history since 1993, SHCP CGPE estimates, CIEP projections with the growth globals of SIM.do §2).
Propósito (procedencia: 03_help/Stata/Po: Purpose (provenance: 03_help/Stata/Poblacion.sthlp “Descripción”; README.md “Programas disponibles” 1): `Poblacion` processes the demographic projections of the Consejo Nacional de Población (CONAPO, National Population Council): Conciliación Demográfica de México 1970–2019 and Proyecciones de la población de México y de las entidades federativas 2020–2070 (pry23, published on 11 September 2023): estimated mid-year population (1970–2070), by state, sex and single year of age. It also produces the population pyramid and demographic transition charts for the year of interest.
Propósito (procedencia: 03_help/Stata/SC: Purpose (provenance: 03_help/Stata/SCN.sthlp “Descripción”; 02_governance/scn-celdas.md header): `SCN` downloads, processes and projects Mexico's Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales (SCN, national accounts), integrating two official INEGI sources: BIE (income, gross output, household consumption, government expenditure and GDP by economic activity) and CSI (accounts by institutional sector: mixed income, social security contributions, subsidies and operating surplus). It allows GDP to be decomposed by its three approaches and the functional distribution of income among labor, capital and depreciation to be obtained; it is an input to TasasEfectivas, GastoPC, Households and NTA. What the engine reads is master/SCN.dta, built by UpdateSCN from the 525 BIE series and the CSI tables frozen in raw/SCN/ (asset scn-congelado-2024.zip; anchors in anioenigh, Package framework from the last frozen year).
Propósito (procedencia: 03_help/Stata/SH: Purpose (provenance: 03_help/Stata/SHRFSP.sthlp “Descripción”): `SHRFSP` downloads and analyzes Mexico's public debt in its broadest measure, combining the SHCP Estadísticas Oportunas (debt stocks, financing requirements, fiscal balance and cost of debt) and the BIE (GDP and deflator). The Saldo Histórico de los Requerimientos Financieros del Sector Público (historical stock of public sector borrowing requirements) includes off-budget liabilities; stock and flow are related by the identity SHRFSP(t) = SHRFSP(t−1) + RFSP(t) + exchange-rate adjustments(t).
